================================================================================
attribute trailing comma, labeled #partial switch, auto_cast default, tagged call
================================================================================

@(private, objc_implement, objc_class = "X", objc_superclass = NS.Object,)
T :: struct {
    using _: NS.Object,
}

visit :: proc(node: ^Node) {
    visitors: #partial switch node.kind {
    case .Binary:
        handle(node)
    }
}

draw :: proc(using ctx: ^Context, auto_cast vertex_count: int, auto_cast first_vertex := 0) {
    use(first_vertex)
}

loc_of :: proc(program: u32, name: string) -> i32 {
    loc := #force_inline gl.GetAttribLocation(program, name)
    return i32(loc)
}
